entries.text: The Updated line follows the latest public change, and this page lists what got better.
The homepage leads with Ian, posts, videos, and a place to ask a question.
Added an Ask page that searches the public site in your browser.
Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, and Twitch are linked on every page.
Added a posts page. The homepage waits to show posts until one is published.
A Play button starts quiet original tones on some pages.
The notebook lists the newest notes first.
